description: Land Acquisition - Mirahawatta, Welimada D/S Division,  Welimada,  Badulla District
categorisation: This gazette notice is exclusively about land acquisition under the Land Acquisition Act, providing detailed descriptions of specific land parcels to be acquired for public purpose, including lot numbers, land names, descriptions, claimants, and extents. It falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) as it deals with land acquisition matters without involving government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
